section: Irrigation in AP - major and medium projects, Handri-Neeva, Pattiseema, Galeru-Nagari, Vamsadhara
subsections: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation
Jalayagnam - plan period and incomplete projects

accepted.s: The Nagarjuna Sagar Project is associated with which of the following combinations?
o: Godavari River and Tenth Five Year Plan
Krishna River and First Five Year Plan
Pennar River and Second Five Year Plan
Vamsadhara River and Fifth Five Year Plan
accepted.x: Nagarjuna Sagar is constructed on the Krishna River and was taken up during the First Five Year Plan. Its foundation stone was laid by Jawaharlal Nehru on 10 December 1955.
accepted.tq: Link the project with its river and plan period rather than relying on the project name alone.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Prakasam Barrage:
1. It is situated on the Krishna River at Vijayawada.
2. Its construction began in February 1954 under the Prakasam ministry.
3. It replaced Cotton's Krishna anicut of the 1850s.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Prakasam Barrage is at Vijayawada on the Krishna, construction began in February 1954 under the Prakasam ministry, and it replaced Cotton's earlier Krishna anicut.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the project’s location, construction period and predecessor.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Telugu Ganga primarily serves which of the following purposes?
o: Supplying drinking water to Vijayawada and irrigating the Krishna delta exclusively
Supplying drinking water to Hyderabad and irrigating Srikakulam
Supplying drinking water to Chennai and irrigating parts of Rayalaseema and Nellore
Supplying drinking water to Tirupati and irrigating only Kadapa
accepted.x: The Telugu Ganga project carries Krishna surplus through the Srisailam-Somasila-Kandaleru-Poondi system, supplying drinking water to Chennai and irrigation water to Rayalaseema and Nellore.
accepted.tq: Identify the project through its combined drinking-water and irrigation beneficiaries.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi, consider the following statements:
1. It is a lift-irrigation project associated with the Krishna River system.
2. It is intended to carry water to drought-prone Rayalaseema.
3. Its target mentioned for completion is March 2027.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 only
1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Handri-Neeva is a Krishna-based lift-irrigation project for drought-prone Rayalaseema, and its stated target is March 2027. Therefore, all three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Combine the project type, beneficiary region and completion target before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Galeru-Nagari Sujala Sravanthi project is associated with which of the following command-area figures and districts?
o: 4.47 lakh acres; Prakasam, Markapuram, Nellore and Kadapa
6.025 lakh acres; Rayalaseema and Srikakulam
20,000 acres; Srikakulam and Nellore
2.60 lakh acres; Kadapa, Annamayya, Tirupati, Chittoor and Nellore
accepted.x: Galeru-Nagari has a stated capacity of 38 TMC and an intended command area of 2.60 lakh acres covering Kadapa, Annamayya, Tirupati, Chittoor and Nellore.
accepted.tq: Use the command-area figure together with the district list to distinguish similar irrigation projects.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Veligonda is correct?
o: It lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram right canal.
It diverts water from the Srisailam reservoir through twin Nallamala tunnels.
It diverts Pennar water through the Krishna delta canals.
It carries Vamsadhara water to Srikakulam through a barrage.
accepted.x: Veligonda is a gravity-diversion project carrying water from Srisailam through twin tunnels in the Nallamala range into Nallamala Sagar.
accepted.tq: Distinguish gravity diversion through tunnels from lift irrigation and barrage-based systems.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The foundation stone of the Veligonda project was laid on:
o: 31 August 2026
10 December 1955
February 1954
5 March 1996
accepted.x: The foundation stone of the Veligonda project was laid on 5 March 1996 by N. Chandrababu Naidu.
accepted.tq: Separate the foundation date from the later inauguration date and other project dates.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Veligonda Phase-I, inaugurated on 31 August 2026, is associated with which of the following?
o: Release of 38 TMC into Srisailam and irrigation of 2.60 lakh acres
Release of 10.70 TMC into Nallamala Sagar, irrigation of about 1.19 lakh acres and supply of drinking water to 4 lakh people
Release of 43.50 TMC into the Krishna delta and irrigation of 4.47 lakh acres
Release of 20,000 TMC into Vamsadhara and irrigation of 6.025 lakh acres
accepted.x: Veligonda Phase-I releases 10.70 TMC into Nallamala Sagar, irrigates about 1.19 lakh acres and supplies drinking water to approximately 4 lakh people.
accepted.tq: Match the inauguration event with its specific release, irrigation and population figures.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Veligonda:
1. Its overall planned command area is 4.47 lakh acres.
2. It is intended to provide drinking water to about 23 lakh people in fluoride-affected areas.
3. Phase-II is expected to add 3.283 lakh acres.
4. Rs 768 crore was paid to 6,206 displaced families.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1, 2 and 3 only
2, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the planned benefits and rehabilitation-related figures of the Veligonda project.
accepted.tq: Verify all quantitative components separately; the option containing all supported statements is correct.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Vamsadhara Phase-II Stage-II is correctly associated with which of the following?
o: Vamsadhara River, Srikakulam and 20,000 acres of new ayacut
Krishna River, Kadapa and 2.60 lakh acres
Pennar River, Nellore and 4.47 lakh acres
Godavari River, East Godavari and 6.025 lakh acres
accepted.x: Vamsadhara Phase-II Stage-II is a project on the Vamsadhara River in Srikakulam, with 93.5% completion and 20,000 acres of proposed new ayacut.
accepted.tq: Use the river, district and new-ayacut figure as a three-part identification test.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following projects contributes to the potential created in the Pennar basin?
o: Veligonda
Somasila
Vamsadhara Phase-II Stage-II
Handri-Neeva
accepted.x: The Somasila project is on the Pennar and contributes to the irrigation potential created in the basin.
accepted.tq: Identify the project through the river basin with which it is specifically linked.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Eleventh Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, which of the following projects were to be completed with the existing water sharing?
o: Nagarjuna Sagar, Prakasam Barrage, Somasila and Polavaram only
Pattiseema, Hirakud, Tehri and Bhakra-Nangal
Handri-Neeva, Telugu Ganga, Galeru-Nagari, Veligonda, Kalwakurthy and Nettempadu
Vamsadhara, Somasila, Nagarjuna Sagar and Polavaram only
accepted.x: The Eleventh Schedule lists Handri-Neeva, Telugu Ganga, Galeru-Nagari, Veligonda, Kalwakurthy and Nettempadu for completion with the existing water-sharing arrangements.
accepted.tq: Recall the statutory project list as a complete group rather than selecting an isolated project.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Pattiseema is best described as:
o: A barrage designed exclusively for hydropower generation
A gravity project transferring Krishna water to the Godavari delta
A lift-irrigation scheme transferring Godavari water to the Krishna delta through the Polavaram right canal
A multipurpose dam on the Pennar River
accepted.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water into the Polavaram right canal to supply the Krishna delta. It is intended as a temporary arrangement until Polavaram is ready.
accepted.tq: Trace the direction of water transfer and the canal connection to identify the scheme.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Polavaram — National Project with irrigation, drinking water, hydropower and flood-control objectives
Prakasam Barrage — Multipurpose dam on the Godavari
Nagarjuna Sagar — Temporary lift scheme until Polavaram is completed
Galeru-Nagari — Project supplying Godavari water to the Krishna delta
accepted.x: Polavaram is a National Project with irrigation, drinking-water, hydropower and flood-control objectives. The other pairs confuse the functions or river systems of different projects.
accepted.tq: Use the project’s official status and multiple objectives to eliminate river and function swaps.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The dam now known as Polavaram was first proposed as:
o: Ramapada Sagaram
Krishna Delta Sagaram
Srisailam Sujala Sravanthi
Nallamala Sagar
accepted.x: The Polavaram dam was initially proposed as “Ramapada Sagaram”; the proposal is credited to Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy.
accepted.tq: Test the earlier name of a famous project, a common official-name trap.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Foundation stone laid for Veligonda
B. Launch of Jalayagnam
C. Inauguration of Veligonda Phase-I
D. Beginning of construction of Prakasam Barrage
o: D, A, B, C
A, D, B, C
D, B, A, C
B, D, A, C
accepted.x: Construction of Prakasam Barrage began in February 1954, Veligonda’s foundation stone was laid in 1996, Jalayagnam began in 2004, and Veligonda Phase-I was inaugurated in 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the two intermediate events.
accepted.sec: Major projects - river, districts, plan period, foundation  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Jalayagnam was launched during which Five Year Plan period?
o: Tenth Five Year Plan
Second Five Year Plan
Eleventh Five Year Plan
First Five Year Plan
accepted.x: Jalayagnam was launched in 2004 by the Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy government during the Tenth Five Year Plan period, 2002–07.
accepted.tq: Associate the programme’s launch year with the corresponding Five Year Plan.
accepted.sec: Jalayagnam - plan period and incomplete projects  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who launched Jalayagnam in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru
N. Chandrababu Naidu
Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy
Tanguturi Prakasam
accepted.x: Jalayagnam was launched in 2004 by the government headed by Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with the political leadership at the time of its launch.
accepted.sec: Jalayagnam - plan period and incomplete projects  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the stated aims and proposed project composition of Jalayagnam?
o: Irrigate 40 TMC, stabilise 38 TMC, and take up 41 minor and 25 major projects
Irrigate 21 lakh acres, stabilise one crore acres, and take up 25 major and 41 minor projects
Irrigate 4.47 lakh acres, stabilise 2.60 lakh acres, and take up 52 minor projects only
Irrigate one crore acres, stabilise 21 lakh acres, and take up 41 major and 25 minor projects
accepted.x: Jalayagnam aimed to irrigate one crore acres and stabilise 21 lakh acres; 41 major and 25 minor projects were proposed.
accepted.tq: Keep the target figures and the major–minor project counts in their correct order.
accepted.sec: Jalayagnam - plan period and incomplete projects  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding Jalayagnam projects is correct?
o: Jalayagnam consisted exclusively of minor irrigation projects.
Polavaram, started in 2005, continues to be treated as a Jalayagnam project, while Veligonda, Handri-Neeva and Galeru-Nagari remained unfinished in 2025–26.
Only Vamsadhara Phase-II remained unfinished in 2025–26 among the listed projects.
Polavaram was completed before Jalayagnam was launched and was not included in it.
accepted.x: Polavaram, begun in 2005, is treated as a Jalayagnam project. Veligonda, Handri-Neeva and Galeru-Nagari were still unfinished in 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Watch for the false exclusion and completion claims in statements about programme projects.
accepted.sec: Jalayagnam - plan period and incomplete projects  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APFAMGS refers to:
o: Andhra Pradesh Farmer Managed Groundwater Systems
Andhra Pradesh Farm Management and General Subsidy
Andhra Pradesh Flood and Major Groundwater Scheme
Andhra Pradesh Flood Monitoring and Groundwater Survey
accepted.x: APFAMGS stands for Andhra Pradesh Farmer Managed Groundwater Systems.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym precisely; similar words such as flood, subsidy and survey are distractors.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under APFAMGS, farmers primarily:
o: Construct only large dams and canals through compulsory land acquisition
Collect rainfall and well-level data, prepare crop-water budgets and voluntarily regulate pumping
Transfer all groundwater monitoring to the Union Government
Regulate irrigation exclusively according to urban water demand
accepted.x: APFAMGS promotes farmer-led collection of rainfall and well-level data, crop-water budgeting on a hydrological-unit basis and voluntary regulation of pumping.
accepted.tq: Apply the participatory-management principle to the functions actually performed by farmers.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about APFAMGS:
1. It was an FAO-supported NGO project.
2. It operated in drought-prone districts.
3. Farmers prepared crop-water budgets on a hydrological-unit basis.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 only
1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: APFAMGS was an FAO-supported NGO initiative in drought-prone districts and used hydrological-unit-based crop-water budgeting by farmers. All three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Check the institutional support, area of operation and operational method separately.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APWALTA is the short form of:
o: Andhra Pradesh Water, Land and Trees Act
Andhra Pradesh Water Allocation and Land Transfer Act
Andhra Pradesh Watershed and Livelihoods Technical Act
Andhra Pradesh Wetlands and Agricultural Land Tax Act
accepted.x: APWALTA means the Andhra Pradesh Water, Land and Trees Act, 2002.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact statutory title from plausible expansions using substituted legal terms.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is a provision associated with APWALTA, 2002?
o: The Act permits indiscriminate digging of borewells in all villages.
The Act applies only to hydropower projects and not to groundwater extraction.
Rainwater-harvesting structures are required on residential, commercial and other premises measuring 200 sq m or more.
Rainwater harvesting is required only on agricultural holdings above 200 hectares.
accepted.x: APWALTA, 2002 requires rainwater-harvesting structures on residential, commercial and other premises of 200 square metres or more and seeks to prevent indiscriminate borewell digging.
accepted.tq: Identify the statutory threshold and reject reversals of the law’s purpose.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding groundwater management in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Groundwater investigations and borewell siting follow APWALTA-2002 norms.
2. About 258 over-exploited villages were proposed for notification under APWALTA.
3. Approximately 3,005 telemetry wells are recorded in the current assessment.
4. Groundwater development is about 30% at the safe stage.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1, 2 and 3 only
2, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four statements reflect the stated groundwater-management position: APWALTA norms guide investigations and siting, 258 villages were proposed for notification, 3,005 telemetry wells were recorded, and development was about 30% at the safe stage.
accepted.tq: Handle a data-dense statement set by verifying each number and institutional reference independently.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the recent trend in borewell-based irrigation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Fewer than 5,000 new borewells are added annually, causing the area per well to increase.
Approximately 40,000–50,000 new borewells are added annually, causing the area irrigated per well to increase.
Approximately 40,000–50,000 new borewells are added annually, causing the area irrigated per well to decline.
No new borewells are added because APWALTA prohibits all groundwater extraction.
accepted.x: Around 40,000–50,000 new borewells are added each year, and consequently the area irrigated by each well is falling.
accepted.tq: Track both the numerical rate and the direction of the trend; the reversed trend is the trap.
accepted.sec: Participatory groundwater management - APFAMGS  [APPSC]
